title: Internal: Large Transfers Between Accounts - Activity Review
content:
## Transfers Above $5,000

- Before processing an agent-assisted transfer of more than $5,000.00 between a customer's accounts, review the source account's recent activity with get_bank_account_transactions_9173.
- If the activity looks normal and the customer confirms, process the transfer with transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291.

## Smaller Transfers

- Transfers of $5,000.00 or less need no additional review.
